s: Din maboy hammepullash veasuy kenadal ubo t' seipim: maboy hammepullash bishne rashayv lirshut harabbim vehu atzmo eno reshut harabbim, kegon sheen rabbim boqeim bo o sheen berochbo t"z amma, veal derek shennitbaer besimman shm"h, veken hammepullash berosho a' lirshut harabbim uberosho hashsheni lekarmelit, o apillu shene rashayv petuchim lekarmelit — eno nittar belechi veqora mikkan velechi veqora mikkan, ella tzarik tzurat petach mikkan velechi o qora mikkan im eno rachab meeser ammot, lepi shetztzurat petach hi kimchitztza gemura, venimtza sheeno patuach ella mitztzad echad veeno niqra mepullash. Abal im rosho echad patuach lirshut harabbim verosho hashsheni lechatzer sheenah meorebet — eno tzarik ella lechi o qora bishne rashayv, shehare rosho happatuach lechatzer eno mechussar mechitztza sham, shemmechitztzot hechatzer mattirot oto, veeno tzarik tiqqun sham ella mippene shepparutz sham bemilluo lemaqom haasur mechamat chesron erub, velo mechamat chesron mechitztzot. Lepikak day sham betiqqun kol shehu. Veyesh omerim shebberosh happatuach lechatzer tzarik sheyyehe sham lechi velo qora, kede sheyyehe nireh sham kesatum, shehallechi niddon mishshum mechitztza, mah sheen ken beqora (uleinyan halaka, bedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel). Vekol zeh keshehechatzer ena regila bemaboy zeh, kegon sheyyesh lah petach lemaboy acher. Abal im hi regila bo — apillu tzurat petach udelatot enan moilot lehattir sham im lo nishtattepa bemaboy zeh im shear hachatzerot happetuchot lo. Veim nishtattepa bo — en tzarik leareb kelal, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shp"z:

Vekol zeh bemaboy. Abal chatzer sheen orkah yater al rochbah, sheenah nitteret ella bepas d' o beb' passin shel mashshehu, veken maboy shechaser echad mittenae maboy beinyan sheeno nittar belechi veqora ella betiqqun hechatzer, en pillush oser bahem, ella apillu hem mepullashim lirshut harabbim bishne rashehem veharabbim niknasin mikkan veyotzeim mikkan — day lahem betiqqun hechatzer mikkan umikkan:

Umeboot shellanu, ap al pi sheddinam kechatzer, sheenan nittarim belechi veqora hoil veen battim vachatzerot petuchim lah karauy, mikkol maqom leinyan pillush enam kechatzer ella kemaboy hammepullash, shetztzarik tzurat petach mikkan velechi o qora mikkan, velo day lahem betiqqun hechatzer mikkan umikkan, hoil uleolam hem qerobim lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit yoter mehechatzer, sherob hachatzerot hem petuchot lemaboy vehammaboy lirshut harabbim o karmelit. Lepikak hechemiru betiqqunam yoter mittiqqun hechatzer leinyan pillush, kemo shemmittaam zeh hechemiru betiqqunam yoter mibbetiqqun hechatzer leinyan orkam yater al rochbam, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"g:

(Ap al pi shetztzurat petach hi kimchitztza gemura, veim asa tzurat petach al gabbe d' qundasin — reshut hayyachid gemura hi min hattora apillu asa ken beemtza reshut harabbim gemura, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"b, ap al pi ken middibre soperim en tzurat petach moelet lirshut harabbim gemura im nishlemu bah kol tenae reshut harabbim shennitbaer besimman shm"h, ella) habba lehakshir reshut harabbim lehattir bah hattiltul tzarik laasot lah delet mikkan vedelet mikkan. Vehu shenninalot ballayla, shenneilat haddelatot oseh otah kechatzer achat shel rabbim. Umeorbin et kullah al derek sheyyitbaer besimman shtz"b, veshub en mebooteha tzerikin shum tiqqun. Veyesh omerim sheen tzarik sheyyihyu neulot ballayla, raq sheyyihyu reuyot linnael, sheim meshuqqaot beapar — mepanneh otan umetaqqenan sheyyihyu reuyot linnael. Veyesh lehachamir kisbara harishona, ap al pi shehaiqqar kisbara haacharona. Ukebar nitbaer besimman shm"h sheyyesh omerim sheakshav en lanu reshut harabbim gemura:

Maboy aqom kemin d' umepullash beb' rashayv lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit, dino keillu haya mepullash beaqmumito lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit. Vetzarik laasot lo tiqqun beaqmumito, lepi shehattiqqun shel maboy mepullash tzarik sheyyehe nireh lekol bene hammaboy, veim ken hattiqqun shebberosh zeh eno moil lehaddarim berosh zeh, vetzarik sheyyaaseh tzurat petach beaqmumito, kede sheyyehe hatztzurat petach — shehu tiqqun shel maboy mepullash — niret lehaddarim kan ulehaddarim kan. Ubishne rashayv yaaseh lekol a' lechi o qora, vekol shekken im yaaseh tzurat petach bekol echad mib' rashayv velechi o qora beaqmumito. Veim asuy kemin ch', tzarik tzurat petach bishne aqmumiyyotayv velechi o qora bishne rashayv. Uleachar sheasa tzurat petach beaqmumit, yekolin lechalleq erubam, shehaddarim mitztzad zeh shel tzurat petach yearebu leatzman vehaddarim mitztzad zeh yearebu leatzman. O im shebbene tzad zeh erebu benehem ubene tzad zeh lo erebu — en oserim ellu al ellu, ella ellu asurim bechelqam veellu muttarim bechelqam, shetztzurat petach choleqet reshuyyot, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"g:

Meboot happetuchim ellu laellu, hare kullam bimqom petichatan zeh lezeh dinam kemaboy aqom, utzerikim sham tiqqun shennitbaer, shekkevan shehachitzon patuach lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit — hare oto maboy sheppatuach elayv chashub kepatuach lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit, mittaam shennitbaer bemaboy echad shemmitaqqem, veken maboy happatuach leoto maboy, veken kullam:

Maboy heasuy kenadal, dehaynu maboy gadol sheharbeh meboot qetannim petuchim lo mishshene tzedadayv, keen sheretz hanniqra nadal sheyyesh lo shura shel raglayim mitztzad zeh umitztzad zeh, verashe hashsheniyyim shel meboot haqqetannim petuchim lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit — oseh lekol echad bimqom petichato laggadol tzurat petach, lepi sheshsham hu kemaboy aqom. Vaapillu im hammeboot haqqetanim shebbetzad zeh hem mekuvvanim mammash keneged otam shebbetzad zeh, shennimtza kol echad mehem im oto hamkuvvan negdo betzad hashsheni hem kemaboy echad mepullash, veen kan iqqum kelal — mikkol maqom hare kol echad mehem hu kemaboy aqom im haggadol, shehare mah sheppatuach laggadol hu kepatuach lirshut harabbim, hoil vei epshar lirot bo hattiqqun shel haggadol, kemo shennitbaer bemaboy echad shemmitaqqem. Veen tzarik lomar im hammeboot shebbetzad zeh enam mekuvvanim keneged otam shebbetzad zeh. Veen tzarik lomar im en sham meboot ella mitztzad echad bilbad:

Uberashe hashsheniyyim shel meboot haqqetannim happetuchim lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit yaaseh lechi o qora. Ubammaboy haggadol, im hu mepullash, oseh tzurat petach berosho haechad, uberosho hab' lechi o qora. Veim eno mepullash — oseh lechi o qora berosho:

Vekol dine maboy aqom hem bemaboy shebbattim vachatzerot petuchim letoko karauy. Abal meboot shellanu, sheen battim vachatzerot petuchim letoko karauy vedinam kechatzer, enam tzerikim shum tiqqun beaqmumitam, kemo sheen tzarik bechatzer aqumma. Veap shelleinyan pillush lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit anu machmirim bahem kemo bemaboy gamur — zehu lepi shehem qerobim sham lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit. Mah sheen ken aqmumitam, sheeno qarob lirshut harabbim, en machmirim bo yoter mibbechatzer:
